title: Smel raw blocks
description: With this datapack you can smelt raw blocks
body:
This datapack adds the possibility of smelting raw blocks. # How to import the datapack 📥 ## Within modrinth app Just click install and chose instalation. After that, datapack should be installed ## Without modrinth app **To import the datapack without modrinth app, unzip “Smelt_raw_blocks.zip”, copy the “Smelt_raw_blocks” folder and paste it into "%appdata%\Roaming\.minecraft\saves\\datapacks"**
# Can I delete the datapack 🗑️ **Yes**, this data pack can be safely removed as it does not change the core mechanics of the game # How to delete data pack 🗑️ ## Within modrinth app Go to instalation settings, and just press "remove project" ## Without modrinth app Go to "%appdata%\Roaming\.minecraft\saves\\datapacks"** and delete "Smelt_raw_blocks" folder.
